replies.author: Mango_
replies.body:
I know you guys spent a lot of time with this map, especially in terms of copying and pasting the bridges. Good to see you fixed it in the end! I'm not sure if you know, but I worked on some of the terra-forming and details near those caves at the end of the bridges ^_^

Anyway, I was always a fan of The Division and this is definitely something that I would like to see in the rotations. The detail is incredible, and both of you (Awarrior and Evo) have produced an amazing map.

On the other hand, I have to agree with Para about the size. It seems just a bit too big for a Nexus map, and I can think of numerous frustrations that would occur because of this. I hope something can be arranged about the size, because this is certainly a stunning map!
